meta.name: Library
meta.shortDescription: Per-user unified media library for Dogebox
meta.longDescription: Front-end for the existing Radarr + Sonarr + Prowlarr + Jellyfin stack. Per-user profiles (filters out items already in each Jellyfin user's library), unified search, one-click add, starter packs, IMDb/Trakt watchlist import, free-text Tonight recommender, and a 🎲 Random Pick button. New in 0.0.9: startup staging is overwrite-safe — read-only files left in /storage/config (e.g. by a backup restore) no longer crash-loop the service. No new indexers, no new download pipeline, no new library model.
